deployment_parity_declaration: Input Availability Parity; Semantic Validation Pending. Equal feature counts do not establish semantic equivalence.

AGE23X.training_source: Continuous person age (0-85) from variable AGE23X in MEPS HC-251.
AGE23X.runtime_source: Exact numeric float value passed via 'age' in intake JSON.

Gender_Male.runtime_source: Binary indicator derived from 'gender' string (1 if 'male'/'m', else 0).

Cardio_ACG.training_source: Sum of 5 discrete MEPS clinician-confirmed binary condition indicators: HIBPDX (hypertension), CHDDX (coronary heart disease), ANGIDX (angina), MIDX (myocardial infarction), STRKDX (stroke). Range 0-5.
Cardio_ACG.runtime_source: Regex heuristic score on 'diseaseInput'. Range 0-2 (2 if severe terms stroke/heart attack/infarction/cad affirmed; 1 if hypertension/cardiac affirmed; 0 if negated/unmentioned).

Metabolic_ACG.training_source: Sum of 2 MEPS binary flags: DIABDX_M18 (diabetes) + CHOLDX (hyperlipidemia). Range 0-2.
Metabolic_ACG.runtime_source: Regex heuristic score on 'diseaseInput'. Range 0-2 (2 if diabetes AND cholesterol/lipids affirmed; 1 if either affirmed; 0 if negated/unmentioned).

Respiratory_ACG.training_source: Sum of 3 MEPS binary flags: ASTHDX (asthma) + CHBRON (chronic bronchitis) + EMPHDX (emphysema). Range 0-3.
Respiratory_ACG.runtime_source: Regex heuristic score on 'diseaseInput'. Range 0-2 (2 if COPD/emphysema affirmed; 1 if asthma/bronchitis affirmed; 0 if negated/unmentioned).

Oncology_ACG.training_source: Single MEPS binary flag CANCERDX (any cancer diagnosis). Range 0-1.
Oncology_ACG.runtime_source: Regex heuristic score on 'diseaseInput'. Range 0-1 (1 if cancer/tumor terms affirmed; 0 if negated/unmentioned).

Musculoskeletal_ACG.training_source: Single MEPS binary flag ARTHDX (arthritis diagnosis). Range 0-1.
Musculoskeletal_ACG.runtime_source: Regex heuristic score on 'diseaseInput'. Range 0-1 (1 if arthritis/joint terms affirmed; 0 if negated/unmentioned).

Psychiatric_ACG.training_source: Sum of 2 MEPS binary flags: ADDPRS42 (past-2-week depression symptoms) + ADHDADDX (pediatric ADHD). Range 0-2.
Psychiatric_ACG.runtime_source: Regex heuristic score on 'diseaseInput'. Range 0-2 (2 if bipolar or depression+anxiety affirmed; 1 if depression/anxiety/adhd affirmed; 0 if negated/unmentioned).

Comorbidity_Count.training_source: Count of positive clusters among the 6 chronic condition clusters (sum(I(cluster > 0))). Range 0-6.
Comorbidity_Count.runtime_source: Identical formula applied to the 6 runtime cluster values.

Frailty_Index.training_source: Composite ADGENH42 + 2*ANYLMI23 + 2*DFCOG42 from self-administered questionnaire. Range 1-9.
Frailty_Index.runtime_source: Imputed conditional mean by age bracket and comorbidity tier from training lookup (unless explicit questionnaire inputs provided).

K6SUM42.training_source: Kessler 6 psychological distress sum (0-24) from self-administered questionnaire.
K6SUM42.runtime_source: Imputed conditional mean by age bracket and comorbidity tier from training lookup (unless explicit questionnaire input provided).
